prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: In the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, a three-phase rollout was confirmed, beginning with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May.
